items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1968-11-01
items.q: it was the Turk Murphy band at that time, and they let me play

ctx.x: Okay, well, how'd you have any previous experience playing with any other band?

When I was 17 or 18, I walked into the Beverly Caverns, the same place. On Monday night, they held it jam session night, which normally just the regular band played. I just walked in one night with my banjo, and it was the Turk Murphy band at that time, and they let me play, and the Pat Pat and the banjo player at that time set out a set, and they let me play the whole night. And there were a lot of tunes I didn't know, but I was able to listen and hear the chords, and a lot of minors and strange keys, you know.
But had you not played with any sort of other band on the West Coast on any regular basses?
